description: Check an agentcv.team.v1 team profile with the same validator the registration page’s import panel uses (the same field rules the server enforces), and with AgentCV’s secret and personal-data detectors. Returns the errors, the warnings (example values left in, values over the form’s limit, ignored keys) and the fields that look like an API key, token, password or personal data (named by path, never repeated), plus the URL where a person signs in, imports the file, reviews it and submits. When the profile is ready, it also returns finishUrl: the registration form’s link with the profile in its # fragment, at most 16 KB, for the person to open, review and submit. Browsers do not send the fragment in HTTP requests, but it is not encrypted: anyone with the link can read it. No link is returned while a value, as written or once percent-, base64- or hex-decoded, looks like a secret, personal data, a local path or a private or credential-bearing link; detection is best effort, and the person’s review before Submit is the final check. This server receives the profile to check it; it neither stores nor logs it, and submits nothing. Read-only.

anyOf.description: Its JSON text, exactly as it would be pasted into the import panel.

profile.description: The profile: the agentcv.team.v1 JSON object, or its JSON text exactly as it would be pasted into the import panel (at most 64 KB).
